suggestions.reason: Both configurations pass all six assertions, so this case does not separate them. A discriminating assertion could check that the plan offers no `<ClientRouter />` drop-in replacement without a spec change, or that the bar is rendered outside <main> / above the sticky header (the with_skill run found the `body > * { z-index: 1 }` stacking trap; the baseline did not).

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are correct but easy for a careful baseline to meet in this repo, where CLAUDE.md already states the no-Tailwind rule.
